stages: 读取腕部鱼眼图像、末端位姿和夹爪开度
Read wrist fisheye images, end-effector poses and jaw widths
以图像采集时刻对齐观测历史
Align the observation history to image capture times
扩散策略生成相对当前末端的目标轨迹及开度
Diffusion policy predicts a trajectory relative to the current hand and a width sequence
按执行器延迟丢弃过期目标，调度余下指令
Discard stale targets per actuator and schedule the remaining commands
机械臂与夹爪跟踪目标，采集新一轮观测
Arm and gripper track targets; acquire the next observations
feedback: 新观测用于下次推理；手持示范的 SLAM 与训练不在实机控制环内。
New measurements condition the next prediction; demonstration SLAM and policy fitting are offline.
test: 投掷按物体计：延迟匹配 105/120，不匹配 69/120；并非 120 个完整任务回合。
Latency matching: 105/120 correctly tossed objects versus 69/120 without it, not 120 complete episodes.

locator: §III-A–C, Fig. 1; §IV, Fig. 4, Tables I–II; App. F
stages: 编码语言指令或目标图像及近期机器人观测
Tokenize the language or image goal and recent robot observations
屏蔽缺失输入，用共享 Transformer 提取读出 token
Mask unavailable inputs and compute readout tokens in the shared transformer
小型扩散头以读出为条件去噪动作块
A small diffusion head denoises an action chunk conditioned on the readout
将动作转换到本体接口，执行一段再观测
Map actions to the robot interface, execute a portion, then observe again
feedback: 按滚动窗口重新查询策略；块内去噪迭代不读取新的实机观测。新增传感器或动作头的微调在线下进行。
Re-query on a rolling observation window; denoising iterations are not sensor feedback. New sensor/action heads are adapted offline.
test: Fig. 4 测预训练已覆盖接口；Table I 约用每域 100 条目标示范微调，每域实测 20 次。
Fig. 4 tests represented interfaces; Table I fine-tunes with about 100 target demonstrations per domain and evaluates 20 trials per domain.

stages: 读取关节、机身倾角、足底接触并保存状态—动作历史
Read joints, body tilt and foot contacts; retain state/action history
慢适应器从 50 步历史估计环境潜变量（约 10 Hz）
Slow adaptor estimates a context latent from 50 history steps (about 10 Hz)
基础策略读取当前状态、上次动作及最近潜变量（100 Hz）
Base policy reads current state, previous action and latest latent (100 Hz)
输出 12 个关节角目标，由 PD 控制器转换为力矩
Output 12 joint-angle targets; PD control converts them into torques
feedback: 每个快周期直接读新状态，不等待慢线程；没有实机摩擦真值，也不在线更新权重。
The fast loop reads new state without waiting for the slow thread. No true friction input or online weight updates.
test: 15 cm 下台阶为 4/5 次成功；Table II 的三种子、多回合统计是仿真。盲感知无法提前看到落差。
The 15 cm step-down succeeded in 4/5 physical trials. Table II averages simulated runs over three seeds; proprioception cannot preview a drop.

stages: 准备：人工扫描带位姿的 RGB-D，建语义与障碍地图
Setup: manually scan posed RGB-D and build semantic and obstacle maps
文本检索目标物，A* 将底盘导航至接近位姿
Retrieve the object by text and navigate the base to an approach pose with A*
现场 RGB-D 上用目标掩模筛选 AnyGrasp 候选，控制手臂抓取
Filter AnyGrasp proposals with a target mask in live RGB-D; execute the grasp
检索放置地点，导航后按当前分割点云计算释放位置
Retrieve the destination, navigate, then compute a drop point from its current segmented cloud
移动手臂并松爪
Move the arm and release
feedback: 抓取与放置重新观测局部场景，但预扫语义地图非持续更新；不是每次失败都自动重试的全局闭环。
Grasp and drop use fresh local perception, not a continuously updated semantic map or a general failure-retry loop.
test: 10 个家庭、171 次实验；原始条件 58.5%，清理/消歧后 82.4%，后者改变了测试条件。
171 trials across ten homes; 58.5% in original conditions versus 82.4% after cleanup/disambiguation, a changed test distribution.
